title: RunInputs
description:
The run inputs, as `inputs.run` stores them. Every part is optional; a part not stated is absent
from the JSON, so what was read writes back the same.

objective.description: What the run aims at. Absent: no objective stated; each method keeps its own rule.

limits.description: What the run must stay within. At most one bound of each kind on a measure.

target_level.description: The output level the run aims at. Absent: concept.

Objective.description: What the run aims at: one design measure and a sense.

DesignMeasure.description: One quantity of the whole design (spec 0017). Not the rules engine's Measure, which is per object.

oneOf.description: The cost: rates times volumes, plus structures (ticket 12). Money, in the rates' currency.
The cut in the river, m³.
The cut on dry land, m³.
The area of the channel's top width outside the river polygon, m².
The number of weirs and locks.

The governing vessel's size. Its unit is open (spec 0017, open assumption 1: deadweight, or
length times beam), so a limit on it is refused until the maintainer settles it.

Limit.description: What the run must stay within: one design measure and a bound.

value.description: The bound, in the measure's unit. Zero or more.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code of a bound on cost (three capital letters). Required for cost, absent for
every other measure.

OutputLevel.description:
How far a run's figures can be trusted (spec 0017): the inputs each reach has decide the level it
reaches. Ordered from the lowest.

oneOf.description: Banks (or a river polygon) and an open elevation model.
Plus spot levels or a partial survey, and a rates table.
Plus bathymetry and a ground survey covering the reach.
